fns.desc: hostapd_dpp_pb_pkex_init: missing 'else' before "if (sae && psk && pass_hex)" after the conf_id>0 if/else-if chain (line 2547) means the two chains are independent, not mutually exclusive; currently benign only because conf_id is hardcoded -1 and never set >0 (see TODO at line 2501-2503) -- if that TODO is ever implemented this becomes a real bug (second chain can overwrite cmd built by the first, or hit the final else's str_clear_free+return even though a valid cmd was already built).
